scenes.say: The sky is blue for the same reason sunsets are red.
scenes.visual: Half sun on a horizon, headline. 'red' lands on @red.

scenes.say: Sunlight is every colour mixed together.
scenes.visual: Sun, one white beam splitting into a fan of rays, labels red to violet.

scenes.say: On its way down, it hits the tiny molecules that make up the air.
scenes.visual: Beam crossing a field of molecules; little arrows bounce off them on @molecules.

scenes.say: They scatter short blue waves around five times more than long red ones.
scenes.visual: Short wave and long wave drawn; counter to 5 on @five.

scenes.say: So blue light reaches you from every part of the sky.
scenes.visual: Dome of sky over a viewer, arrows from every direction on @every.

scenes.say: At sunset, light crosses far more air. The blue scatters away, and the reds are left.
scenes.visual: Curved Earth, low sun, long path through the air band; 'the reds are left' on @reds.
